_readme: CL textbook integrated tasks (综合任务) read for inquiry, 3 Nov 2026. A unit is listed when its 综合任务 has students find out for themselves (research, interview, survey, field work or tracking their own data) and then make or present something. Tasks that only discuss, rank, choose from a given list or write a personal letter are left out. Department reading, not a CPDD tag.
